rule: g <= -8.0 and cagey no-loss chance >= 0.85: the bet stays in its normal place and is flagged, with p_r, p_c and g shown in the row and listed in a short 'For inspection' section of the summary. The flag never removes or reorders a bet. Needs both views (a bet with one view missing can't carry it).

comparable.definition: safe picks (cagey no-loss >= 0.75) on which the research view's no-loss chance was at least 8 points below the cagey tier's

note: Offline backtest offers (Bet365 prices with a synthetic Pinnacle margin where Pinnacle is missing); descriptive only, never used to change a pick or a ranking.
